title: East Africa Overland
excerpt: Sixteen days from Nairobi to Zanzibar — crossing the Masai Mara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro, and coastal forest.

itinerary.title: Nairobi Arrival
itinerary.description: Giraffe Centre at dusk. Team dinner in Karen, the leafy suburb named for Blixen.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara — Arrival
itinerary.description: Fly west to the Mara. Evening game drive. The density of wildlife here requires recalibration.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara — Full Day
itinerary.description: Dawn balloon optional. The Big Five possible before 9am. Masai guide leads afternoon bush walk.

itinerary.title: Masai Village + Transit
itinerary.description: Masai boma visit. Crossing into Tanzania at Isebania.

itinerary.title: Serengeti — Western Corridor
itinerary.description: The wildebeest corridor. Migration timing can mean witnessing thousands of animals moving as one.

itinerary.title: Serengeti — Central Plains
itinerary.description: The classic savanna image. Flat-topped acacia, lion on termite mound, the horizon just sky.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Rim
itinerary.description: Camp on the crater rim at 2,400m. Cloud forest. Stars through the forest canopy.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Descent
itinerary.description: 600m descent into the crater floor. Highest wildlife density on earth within a contained area.

itinerary.title: Olduvai Gorge + Tarangire
itinerary.description: The birthplace of humanity. Then elephant country — Tarangire's enormous herds around the river.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara
itinerary.description: Flamingo-pink shores. Tree-climbing lions in the fever acacias.

itinerary.title: Mount Kilimanjaro View Day
itinerary.description: Amboseli for the classic Kilimanjaro + elephant composition. The mountain that earns its own section of sky.

itinerary.title: Coast Drive to Dar es Salaam
itinerary.description: Transition from savanna to coast. Indian Ocean first glimpsed from the escarpment edge.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar — Stone Town
itinerary.description: Ferry to the island. Spice market, coral stone labyrinth, rooftop sunset over the dhow harbor.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar — North Coast
itinerary.description: Nungwi beach. Snorkel the reef. Dhow sailing at sunset. Seafood straight from the catch.

itinerary.title: Jozani Forest
itinerary.description: Red colobus monkeys — endemic to Zanzibar. Mangrove boardwalk. Final inland journey.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Flights from Zanzibar direct. Expedition closed.

included: OVERLAND guide + local Masai and Chagga specialists
All accommodation (lodges and luxury tented camps)
gear: Neutral-tone clothing (khaki, olive, tan — bright colors disturb wildlife)
